description: Details of glazed screen (condition 2) submitted pursuant of planning permission 01102/41/P5 dated 23/07/2019 for proposed second floor rear terrace and changing existing window into a door
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Unless within 1 month of the date of this decision full details of the opacity and a sample of the 1.8 metre high obscure glazed screen ('the scheme') is submitted in writing to the local planning authority for approval, and unless the approved scheme is implemented within 1 month of the local planning authority's approval, the use of the terrace shall cease.

Upon implementation of the approved scheme specified in this condition, that scheme shall thereafter be retained.

 In the event of a legal challenge to this decision, or to a decision made pursuant to the procedure set out in this condition, the operation of the time limits specified in this condition will be suspended until that legal challenge has been finally determined.
